title: thevetiana
intro: Thevetiana, commonly known as yellow oleander, is a plant species that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Thevetiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include thevetin, thevetine, and thevetin-A, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cytotoxic activities. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including treating fever, rheumatism, and snake bites, although its use should be cautioned due to potential toxicity.
